description.narrative: Makushi Research Unit is an indigenous women-led umbrella organization of 20 indigenous villages and communities in the North Rupununi, Guyana. They work to defend the rights of indigenous women and fight for gender equality, while also preserving their heritage, language, and culture. They do community outreach and capacity strengthening activities, involving in-person gatherings and training in different villages. They also run a community radio program through which they conduct advocacy on key issues and educate both women and men, and they provide counselling to women victims of gender-based violence. The grant will support the following priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries and stipends, banks fees, phone data, office supplies, equipment, and others; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as transportation, fuel, accommodation, meals, materials, and others; - Radio program broadcasting.
